judged_by: THREE AI RATERS, majority vote - NOT human. 'answerable' means at least one abstract in the 100-paper collection addresses the question. Claude's first pass and two independent Claude subagents (full title+abstract of all 100 papers, questions shuffled) agreed on all 40 (kappa {'me-A': 1.0, 'me-B': 1.0, 'A-B': 1.0}). Caveat: the definition is abstract-level while the system answers from full text, so two questions labelled unanswerable are answerable in a narrower setting from full text ('borderline'); they are NOT relabelled, and the refusal numbers report them as unanswerable. Review before presenting.
